_howto: Guided setup for Time & Attendance (Demo / Setup mode).
title: Set up Time & Attendance
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo, so nothing affects your live system until you push it. Each step checks itself against what you've set up.

steps.title: How the engine calculates
steps.why: Rounding, duplicate clockings, night shifts, public holidays and leave on premium days. Everything else is calculated with these.

steps.title: Public holidays
steps.why: The public holidays for the year, and whether people get normal time for them.
steps.todo: At least one active public holiday.

steps.title: Shift rules
steps.why: The shifts people work. Attendance, overtime and violations are all calculated from them.

steps.title: Overtime rules
steps.why: BCEA limits and pay rates for everyone, and rulesets for groups that differ.

steps.title: Department defaults
steps.why: Each department's default shift, payroll period and geofences, so new people start on the right ones.

steps.title: Payroll periods
steps.why: The cycles people are paid on. Everyone must be on one.
steps.todo: At least one payroll period, with every active employee on one.

steps.title: Who approves
steps.why: Approvers for overtime, leave and exceptions, per department or person.
steps.todo: At least one approval routing rule.

steps.title: Weekly roster
steps.why: Who works which shift each day. Practise building a week here.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Settings › Bulk Analyzer: recalculate last week for one department.
  2. Actual Attendance: check the worked hours and overtime.
  3. OT Validations and Auto-Violations: approve or dismiss something.
  4. Team View › Visual: move a clock time, save, and approve the day.
  5. Reports: run a weekly attendance summary.
Attendance and approvals are never pushed to live.
